definitions.explanation: The reddish-brown coating that forms on iron or steel when exposed to moisture and air.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チェーン→チェーン：08833_cheen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{錆|さび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ついている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: There's rust on the bicycle chain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦ざらし→ざらし：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{錆|さび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: If you leave it exposed to rain, it will rust.

notes:
{錆|さび} refers to the oxidation that forms on metal surfaces, especially iron and steel when exposed to moisture.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {錆|さび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つく→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to become rusty
- {錆|さび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: rust appears
- {錆|さび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧: to remove rust
- {錆|さび}⟦{止|ど}め→止め：noentry⟧: rust prevention/rust inhibitor
- {錆|さび}⟦だらけ→だらけ：18372_darake⟧: covered in rust

FORMS:
⟦{錆|さ}びる→錆びる：07412_sabiru⟧ is the verb meaning 'to rust.' Example: ⟦{鉄|てつ}→鉄：02225_tetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{錆|さ}びた→錆びる：07412_sabiru⟧ (the iron rusted).

TYPES OF RUST:
- ⟦{赤錆|あかさび}→赤錆：noentry⟧: red rust (iron oxide, the most common type)
- ⟦{青錆|あおさび}→青錆：noentry⟧: verdigris (green patina on copper or bronze)
- ⟦{黒錆|くろさび}→黒錆：noentry⟧: black rust (stable oxide, sometimes protective)

USAGE:
⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{錆|さ}びる→錆びる：07412_sabiru⟧ means 'to lose one's skill/touch' from disuse.
